name: Being Super
source:
You are 21 years old. You live with your roommate's mom (relation can be changed in-game!) and your roommate (relation can be changed in-game!). Your father died before you were born, you don't know how but... We'll get to that later... Much later. On the day you were born, a meteor shower struck the unassuming city of Quiettown almost killing you. Because of this, you were prescribed to take pills that tasted like hell itself would spit them back out. This story begins as your mom drives you to your final check-up at the hospital. It was the day that changed your life forever.

You discover that your father was a powerful, alien super-villain who tried to conquer the world but ultimately failed (He died). If that wasn't bad enough YOU have just found out that you also have superpowers! Will you use them for good? Or will you pick up where your father left off and become the Earth's evil god-king! If that wasn't enough there is a portal letting loose powerful beings from other universes both good and evil.
translation:
你今年21岁。你与室友的妈妈（关系可以在游戏中更改！）和你的室友（关系可以在游戏中更改！）住在一起。你的父亲在你出生之前就去世了，你不知道是怎么死的，但是……我们稍后会讲到……很久以后。在你出生的那天，一场流星雨袭击了不起眼的安静镇，几乎杀死了你。正因为如此，你被要求服用那些尝起来就像地狱一样会把它们吐出来的药片。这个故事开始于你妈妈开车送你去医院做最后检查时。那一天永远改变了你的生活。

你发现你的父亲是一个强大的外星超级恶棍，他试图征服世界但最终失败了（他死了）。如果这还不够糟糕的话，你刚刚发现自己也拥有超能力！你会永远使用它们吗？或者你会继承你父亲的遗志，成为地球上的邪恶神王！如果这还不够，还有一个门户可以释放来自其他宇宙的强大生物，无论是善的还是邪恶的。
